expectations.text: 准确解释OpenProcess 0x410及ReadProcessMemory/VirtualQueryEx，并不把窗口RestoreLayer66称为游戏补丁恢复。
expectations.evidence: outputs/report.md:20-24、46、54-58准确说明1040=0x410=PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION|PROCESS_VM_READ、ReadProcessMemory完整读取与VirtualQueryEx区域查询，RestoreLayer66恢复窗口Z序。独立核对Native.cs:25-45、PlayerInfoReader.cs:2311/2350及SquadMarkerWindow.cs:146-163：SetWindowPos(base.Handle, new IntPtr(-1), ...,19u)，未将它解释为游戏补丁恢复；只读结论限定已核查路径。
